preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
For each test case, the length of the string n must be between 2 and 100, and the number of queries q must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i < r_i <= n for l_i, r_i in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid indices l_i and r_i such that 1 <= l_i < r_i <= n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(len(subseq) >= 2 and subseq == s[l_i-1:r_i] for subseq in subsequences) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: For each query, output 'YES' if there exists a good subsequence equal to the substring s[l_i...r_i], otherwise output 'NO'.
